I reject this sort of zero-sum game where building Australian sovereignty in AI must come at the expense of creatives or at diminishing the rights of creatives. At the moment, yes, we want deals, but we want creatives paid properly for their work. And the situation that we find ourselves in at the moment is that they’re not.
